episodes.synopsis: Mahiru was an artist once, but she lost her spark when her friends ridiculed her art. However, a chance encounter with an anonymous singer could reignite her passion.
episodes.title: Jellyfish in the Night

episodes.synopsis: Kano was someone else once, a fact Mei knows all too well. When the composer finally sees the former idol again, all she feels is disappointment.
episodes.title: Mei the Fangirl

episodes.synopsis: Mahiru asks a VTuber friend for help, and, on the surface, Kiui radiates the same confidence as the superheroes she adores. But she's hiding something beneath her digital mask.
episodes.title: Kiui Watase

episodes.synopsis: JELEE celebrates viewer response to their new video, but it doesn't take long before differences of opinion form while working on their next project.
episodes.title: Double A-Side

episodes.synopsis: Their music video went viral but not in the way they expected. They now have more fans, but Mahiru’s confidence is shattered after reading a comment criticizing her art.
episodes.title: Viewer Comments

episodes.synopsis: JELEE receives a commission request from an idol who dreams of becoming famous, but her secrets mean the situation is more complicated than the group ever imagined.
episodes.title: 31 (Thirty-One)

episodes.synopsis: Now in their final year of high school, they must all decide what comes next and what their futures hold.
episodes.title: Daybreak

episodes.synopsis: JELEE’s first anniversary is coming up and they want to mark the occasion with something truly special. But their plan is threatened when a YTuber deduces Kano’s identity.
episodes.title: Covert Gig

episodes.synopsis: Kano's mother offers Mahiru a life-altering opportunity; the kind that launches careers. But it may clash with JELEE's plans. And there’s the matter of Kano's reaction...
episodes.title: Take a Look at Reality

episodes.synopsis: JELEE is on the brink of collapse, and it falls upon Mei and Kiui to pick up the pieces and ensure the group doesn't disband for good.
episodes.title: The Idolized

episodes.synopsis: JELEE may have emerged intact, but Mahiru struggles to meet Yukine’s requested revisions. With the deadline hanging over her head, she and Kiui look back on an old art class.
episodes.title: What I Love

episodes.synopsis: Yukine invites JELEE to perform with the Sunflower Dolls at Mahiru’s request. Now, Kano must not only find her reason to sing, but overcome the demons from her past.
episodes.title: JELEE
